detail.title: Born Too Early: Perceived Recency Discontinuity and Scientific Recognition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No potential conflict of interest was reported by the authors.

detail.abstract: Temporal labels, such as years, months, and quarters, are common ways of representing time, yet they are often treated as neutral background information. We find evidence of a temporal-labeling mechanism in which coarse-grained labels divide continuous time into discrete stages, making adjacent objects appear more or less recent than they objectively are and thereby shaping judgment and choice. We define this label-induced discontinuity in recognition as the Perceived Recency Discontinuity (PRD) effect. We formalize how temporal labels transform objective age into subjective age and generate perceived recency differences that can affect behavior. Scientific citation provides an especially suitable setting for observing the PRD effect. Using 71,257 FT50 journal papers and more than 13.61 million citation events, we construct a regression discontinuity design around year boundaries. Papers published just before a year boundary receive about 14 fewer citations within five years than those published just after it, corresponding to a 19.6% citation advantage for papers on the right side of the boundary. A behavioral experiment on reference selection provides micro-level evidence consistent with the interpretation that year labels shift perceived recency. The findings show that formal temporal labels are institutionalized signals that shape judgment, opportunity allocation, and downstream outcomes.

AI.tldr: 论文发现时间标签（如年份）会产生“感知近时性不连续效应”（PRD）：粗粒度标签将连续时间分割成离散阶段，使相邻对象看起来比实际情况更新或更旧，从而影响判断与行为。基于71,257篇FT50期刊论文和超1,361万次引用数据的断点回归分析显示，年份边界两侧的论文五年被引量存在约14次（19.6%）的显著差异。
AI.research_question: 时间标签（如年份、季度等）如何通过分割连续时间影响人们对事物“近时性”的感知，进而塑造判断与选择行为？
AI.motivation: 时间标签常被视为中性背景信息，但作者发现这些粗粒度标签可能通过创造离散的时间阶段，使客观上时间接近的对象在主观感知上出现“近时性断裂”，这一问题尚未被系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标签诱导的感知近时性不连续效应（Perceived Recency Discontinuity, PRD），即粗粒度时间标签将连续时间分割为离散阶段，导致跨越标签边界的对象在主观感知上出现近时性差异。
AI.method: 基于71,257篇FT50期刊论文和超过1,361万次引用事件，采用断点回归设计（Regression Discontinuity Design），以年份边界为断点进行分析，并结合行为实验提供微观层面的证据。
AI.findings: 在年份边界之前发表的论文比之后发表的论文，五年内平均少获得约14次引用，相当于右侧论文享有19.6%的引用优势。行为实验验证了这一效应源于年份标签改变了人们对“近时性”的主观感知。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提出并实证检验了“感知近时性不连续效应”（PRD），揭示了时间标签作为制度化信号而非中性背景信息，能够塑造人们的感知与判断，拓展了时间认知与决策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒学者、评价机构及政策制定者注意时间标签可能带来的系统性偏差，为学术评价、论文发表时机选择以及更广泛领域中的时机决策提供指导。

title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Depression Detection: Integrating Vision-Language Transformers with Clinical Proxies
affiliations: BRAC University, United International University, BRAC University, BRAC University and BRAC University

detail.title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Depression Detection: Integrating Vision-Language Transformers with Clinical Proxies
detail.abstract: Depression affects over 332 million individuals globally, yet most of the people with early symptoms never access professional assessment, and existing computational screening tools rarely align with validated clinical frameworks. This study evaluates five vision-language transformer architectures— CLIP, ImageBind, ALIGN, ViLT, and BEiT- —for passive depression detection from social media, integrating digital phenotypic proxies of all 21 Beck Depression Inventory II (BDI-II) components and five therapeutic engagement categories derived via a context-aware keyword algorithm. A secondary analysis was conducted on a publicly available, de-identified multimodal Twitter dataset comprising 2,804 users (1,402 depressed, 1,402 controls; 54,050 posts). Data were partitioned at the user level to prevent leakage (70% train and 30% hold-out test), and class balance was restored by stratified under-sampling. CLIP achieved the highest accuracy of 97.85% (F1 = 0.984; 95% CI: 0.987–0.994) on the balanced test set, with sensitivity 97.4% and specificity 97.2%. At a realistic 5% population prevalence, positive predictive value decreased to 67.4%, confirming the tool’s role as a sensitive screening instrument requiring clinical follow-up rather than a standalone diagnostic. Clinical proxy integration improved accuracy by 7.83 percentage points over image-plus-text baselines (𝑝<0.001), with LIME analysis revealing that proxies contributed 62% of the predictive signal. A novel “therapeutic gap”— high help-seeking mentions co-occurring with 58% lower therapeutic engagement—was identified as a clinically actionable intervention target. These findings demonstrate that grounding vision-language models in validated clinical constructs substantially enhances both performance and interpretability for mental health informatics.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估五种视觉-语言Transformer架构（CLIP、ImageBind、ALIGN、ViLT、BEiT-），结合贝克抑郁量表第二版（BDI-II）的21个数字表型代理指标，用于社交媒体被动抑郁检测。CLIP模型在平衡测试集中达到97.85%准确率，临床代理整合使准确率提升7.83个百分点，并发现"治疗缺口"作为临床可干预靶点。
AI.research_question: 如何利用视觉-语言Transformer架构和临床验证量表（BDI-II）的数字表型代理，提升社交媒体被动抑郁检测的准确性与临床可解释性？
AI.motivation: 全球超过3.32亿人受抑郁症影响，但大多数早期症状者从未获得专业评估，现有计算筛查工具很少与经过验证的临床框架对齐。
AI.theoretical_framework: 视觉-语言Transformer（CLIP、ImageBind、ALIGN、ViLT、BEiT-）、贝克抑郁量表第二版（BDI-II）的21个组件、数字表型代理、治疗参与类别。
AI.method: 对包含2,804名用户（1,402名抑郁症患者，1,402名对照组；54,050条帖子）的公开多模态Twitter数据集进行二次分析。采用用户级数据分区（70%训练，30%留出测试），通过分层欠采样恢复类别平衡，评估五种视觉-语言Transformer架构，并整合基于上下文感知关键词算法得出的BDI-II全部21个组件及五个治疗参与类别的数字表型代理。
AI.findings: CLIP模型在平衡测试集中达到97.85%准确率（F1=0.984；95%CI: 0.987-0.994），敏感度97.4%，特异度97.2%。在5%现实患病率下，阳性预测值降至67.4%。临床代理整合使准确率提升7.83个百分点（p<0.001），LIME分析显示代理贡献了62%的预测信号。发现"治疗缺口"——高求助提及与58%较低治疗参与共现。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将BDI-II全部21个组件作为数字表型代理系统性地整合进视觉-语言Transformer架构进行抑郁检测，证实了临床框架与深度学习模型的有效融合路径。
AI.practical_contributions: CLIP模型可作为高敏感度筛查工具（需临床随访而非独立诊断），识别出的"治疗缺口"为临床干预提供了明确靶点，展示了将验证性临床构念嵌入视觉-语言模型可显著提升心理健康信息学的表现与可解释性。

title: Real Options Valuation of New Nuclear Power Plants in the U.S. Energy Market
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Illinois Institute of Technology - Stuart School of Business and University of Wisconsin - Whitewater

detail.title: Real Options Valuation of New Nuclear Power Plants in the U.S. Energy Market
detail.abstract: This study evaluates the economic viability and optimal investment timing of new nuclear power plants in the U.S. through a real options valuation (ROV) framework. Recognizing the high capital intensity, regulatory uncertainty, and long lead times associated with nuclear development, we implement a Least Squares Monte Carlo (LSMC) approach to capture flexibility in investment timing under uncertainty. Our model incorporates stochastic dynamics for electricity and uranium prices, probabilistic cost overruns, political risk via the Climate Policy Uncertainty (CPU) index, and regulatory scenarios reflecting recent federal directives. We compare the real option value against a traditional Net Present Value (NPV) benchmark and demonstrate that deferring investment under unfavorable conditions significantly enhances project value. Electricity price is found to be the primary economic driver, while discount rates and CAPEX variability strongly influence timing and feasibility. Regulatory streamlining, modeled after the Trump Administration's executive order reducing approval time, materially advances commercial operation timelines and improves option value. Policy uncertainty, although not directly altering mean investment timing, increases dispersion. Our findings underscore the strategic importance of flexible capital allocation and policy design in enabling cost-effective, low-carbon infrastructure deployment. This research contributes to the literature by offering a comprehensive stochastic ROV framework tailored to nuclear energy and providing actionable insights for investors and policymakers navigating complex energy transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实物期权估值（ROV）框架，利用最小二乘蒙特卡洛（LSMC）方法，评估美国新建核电站的经济可行性与最优投资时机，发现延迟投资、电价波动、贴现率与监管简化是关键影响因素。
AI.research_question: 美国新建核电站的经济可行性如何？最优投资时机在不确定性下如何确定？
AI.motivation: 核电项目资本密集、监管不确定、建设周期长，传统NPV方法无法捕捉灵活投资决策的价值，需要更精准的估值框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权理论（ROV）、最小二乘蒙特卡洛（LSMC）方法、净现值（NPV）基准对比。
AI.method: 基于LSMC的实物期权定价模型，纳入电价与铀价随机过程、成本超支概率、气候政策不确定性（CPU）指数及监管情景模拟。
AI.findings: ①延迟不利条件下的投资可显著提升项目价值；②电价是主要经济驱动因素；③贴现率与资本支出（CAPEX）波动显著影响投资时机与可行性；④监管简化（如行政令缩短审批时间）可提前商业运营并提升期权价值；⑤政策不确定性增加投资时机的离散度但不改变均值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为核能领域提供了综合性的随机实物期权估值框架，弥补了传统NPV方法忽略管理灵活性的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和决策者在复杂能源转型背景下提供灵活资本配置与政策设计的可操作见解，支持低成本低碳基础设施部署。

title: Learning Market Volatility Distributions: A Distributional Graph Neural Architecture for Probabilistic Price Forecasting in the Australian National Electricity Market
affiliations: Griffith University, Griffith University, Griffith University and Griffith University

detail.title: Learning Market Volatility Distributions: A Distributional Graph Neural Architecture for Probabilistic Price Forecasting in the Australian National Electricity Market
detail.abstract: The increasing integration of variable renewable energy (VRE) sources within the Australian National Electricity Market (NEM) has transformed the price formation mechanisms, resulting in a bi-modal distribution characterised by recurrent negative pricing and scarcity. Conventional deterministic forecasting models that primarily optimise measures of central tendency are inadequate in capturing these asymmetric tail risks that now dominate market behaviour. Consequently, battery energy storage system (BESS) operators face substantial challenges in risk management and profitability due to the lack of reliable probabilistic forecasts. To address this challenge, we present a hybrid Distributional Graph Neural Network architecture integrating Squeeze-and-Excitation CNNs with Long Short-Term Memory networks (D-GNN-SE-LSTM). The proposed framework advances a spatiotemporal probabilistic forecasting incorporating a topology-aware Graph Attention Network (GATv2) for estimating the distribution of price shocks across connected regions. In contrast to existing traditional methods, the proposed model adopts a distributional perspective employing a parametric Gaussian output layer to quantify residual uncertainty. Empirical evaluation is conducted using 4 years of high-frequency 5-minute resolution (5MS) data from the NEM ensuring exposure to a wide spectrum of operational regimes, including extreme price excursions. The results show an average reduction of 10.3% in the interval score across five regions along with a significant decrease in coverage violations during periods of market volatility. The proposed framework integrates data-driven forecasting with grid-aware prediction, offering an end-to-end approach that yields a more robust analytical toolkit for market participants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合分布图神经网络架构（D-GNN-SE-LSTM），用于澳大利亚国家电力市场中电池储能系统的短期概率价格预测，相比传统确定性模型，在区间评分上平均降低10.3%，并显著减少市场波动期间的覆盖违规。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够捕捉澳大利亚国家电力市场中由可变可再生能源整合导致的双峰价格分布（负价格与稀缺性）的短期概率预测模型，以支持电池储能系统的风险管理和盈利决策？
AI.motivation: 随着VRE在NEM中的渗透率上升，市场价格呈现双峰分布（频繁负价格与稀缺定价），传统确定性预测模型仅优化中心趋势无法捕捉尾部风险，导致BESS运营商的盈利与风险管理面临严峻挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布图神经网络（Distributional GNN）、Squeeze-and-Excitation CNN、LSTM、图注意力网络（GATv2）、参数化高斯输出层、概率预测理论。
AI.method: 构建混合D-GNN-SE-LSTM架构：结合SE-CNN提取空间特征、LSTM捕捉时间依赖、GATv2实现拓扑感知的跨区域价格冲击估计，最后通过参数化高斯层输出概率分布。
AI.findings: 使用NEM的4年5分钟高频数据验证，模型在5个区域的平均区间评分降低10.3%，市场波动期间的覆盖违规显著减少，证明其在极端价格事件下的预测鲁棒性优于传统方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 将拓扑感知的图注意力机制与分布预测框架相结合，提出了一个端到端的时空概率预测范式，为电力市场中非对称尾部风险的量化提供了新的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为BESS运营商提供了更可靠的短期概率价格预测工具，有助于优化充放电策略、对冲价格风险、提升储能系统在VRE高渗透市场中的经济可行性。

title: Tourism Designation and Green Innovation: Evidence from China's 5A National Tourist Attractions
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology and Beijing Institute of Technology

detail.title: Tourism Designation and Green Innovation: Evidence from China's 5A National Tourist Attractions
detail.abstract: We study whether place-based tourism policy can promote corporate green innovation in a developing economy. Exploiting the staggered rollout of China's 5A National Tourist Attraction designation across 240 prefectures during 2003 to 2024, we find that designation increases green patent applications by 19%, concentrated in substantive invention patents. The result survives heterogeneity-robust estimators, an instrumental variable strategy using historical cultural heritage sites, propensity score matching, placebo tests, and extensive sensitivity checks. Mediation analysis reveals that public environmental attention, rather than direct regulatory coercion, serves as the dominant transmission channel. The treatment effect concentrates among tourism-linked, high-absorptive-capacity, and non-polluting firms, consistent with opportunity-driven voluntary adoption. A Spatial Durbin Model documents significant positive spillovers to neighboring cities, implying that conventional within-jurisdiction evaluations underestimate aggregate innovation gains by approximately one-fifth. These findings demonstrate that tourism governance can generate environmental innovation externalities extending well beyond the tourism sector.

AI.tldr: 利用中国5A级旅游景区评选的准自然实验，研究发现旅游政策能促进企业绿色创新，主要机制是公众环境关注而非直接监管压力，且存在显著的正向空间溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 以旅游为导向的地方政策能否促进发展中国家的企业绿色创新？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对旅游政策的环境外部性关注不足，且缺乏因果证据；旅游政策作为非强制性环境规制，是否能通过市场机制激发企业绿色创新，具有重要的理论和政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机会驱动型自愿采纳理论；公众注意力机制；空间溢出效应理论。
AI.method: 采用中国240个地级市2003-2024年5A级景区评选的渐进双重差分模型，辅以异质性稳健估计量、工具变量（历史文化遗址）、倾向得分匹配、安慰剂检验、空间杜宾模型等。
AI.findings: 5A景区评选使当地企业绿色专利申请量增加19%，集中在实质性发明专利；机制为公众环境注意力而非直接监管；效应集中于旅游关联、高吸收能力和非污染企业；存在显著正向空间溢出效应，忽略溢出会低估约五分之一的总创新收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为旅游政策的绿色创新效应提供因果证据；揭示了"公众注意力"这一非监管机制在市场激励型环境治理中的作用；拓展了环境创新的空间溢出理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家利用旅游政策促进绿色转型提供了可行路径；提示政策评估应纳入空间溢出效应，避免低估整体效益。

title: Self-Supervised Mixture of Uncertainties for Semantically Faithful Diffusion Reconstruction
affiliations: CVR College Of Engineering, affiliation not provided to SSRN, VNR Vignana Jyothi Institute of Engineering and Technology, Geethanjali College of Engineering and Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Self-Supervised Mixture of Uncertainties for Semantically Faithful Diffusion Reconstruction
detail.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved strong performance in image generation and reconstruction, but their outputs often suffer from artifacts that are difficult to interpret through a single error measure. Semantic drift, epistemic uncertainty, and posterior reconstruction ambiguity are usually treated as separate problems, although they frequently appear as correlated effects during the denoising process. This work proposes a unified framework that models these artifacts as latent uncertainty modes within an EM-guided diffusion process. The proposed method introduces a Mixture-of-Uncertainties formulation in which each spatial region or latent component is assigned probabilistic responsibilities corresponding to semantic inconsistency, model uncertainty, and reconstruction ambiguity. In the E-step, the model estimates uncertainty responsibilities using self-supervised signals derived from semantic consistency, posterior sample variance, and observation-level reconstruction residuals. In the M-step, these responsibilities guide the diffusion refinement trajectory through responsibility-weighted correction losses. The framework does not require manually annotated artifact labels, as uncertainty cues are obtained from controlled corruptions, multi-sample disagreement, and representation-level consistency. By integrating uncertainty estimation directly into diffusion reconstruction, the proposed approach aims to generate perceptually realistic outputs while preserving semantic fidelity and exposing hallucination-prone regions. This unified formulation provides a principled direction for reliable image reconstruction, uncertainty-aware generation, and interpretable diffusion refinement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种EM引导的扩散模型统一框架，将语义漂移、认知不确定性和后验重建模糊性建模为潜在不确定性模式，通过Mixture-of-Uncertainties公式和EM迭代实现不确定性感知的图像重建与去伪影。
AI.research_question: 如何统一建模扩散模型输出中的语义漂移、认知不确定性和后验重建模糊性等伪影，并实现无监督的可解释去伪影？
AI.motivation: 扩散模型存在多种难以通过单一误差度量的伪影（语义漂移、认知不确定性、重建模糊性），这些伪影常表现为相关效应，但现有方法将它们视为独立问题处理。
AI.theoretical_framework: EM引导的扩散过程、Mixture-of-Uncertainties公式（语义不一致性、模型不确定性、重建模糊性的概率责任分配）
AI.method: 在E步中利用自监督信号（语义一致性、后验样本方差、重建残差）估计不确定性责任；在M步中通过责任加权的校正损失引导扩散精炼轨迹。无需人工标注，不确定性线索来自控制性污染、多样本分歧和表征级一致性。
AI.findings: 该方法能在保持语义保真度的同时生成感知上真实的输出，暴露易产生幻觉的区域，提供可解释的扩散精炼。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多种伪影统一为潜在不确定性模式，提出Mixture-of-Uncertainties公式与EM优化框架，为不确定性感知扩散过程提供了原则性方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现无需人工标注的伪影检测与校正，可用于可靠的图像重建、不确定性感知生成和可解释的扩散精炼。
